text:
Eli: Quick personal share — Sam and I tied the knot last weekend! ❤️ Were hosting a tiny office toast this Friday at 3pm in the kitchen if anyone wants to swing by. No pressure at all.
Sam: whoa thanks everyone!! overwhelmed in the best way. registry link if folks ask: https://registry.example.com/sam-eli (no gifts needed) 
Asha: CONGRATS!!! :tada: can we do a 1-question poll — cake flavor? chocolate / lemon / vanilla
Marco: chocolate all the way :chocolate_bar: 
Priya: lemon for me, itll be nice and fresh
Noor: vanilla + extra frosting pls :yum:
Mira: ill bring savory snacks (mini quiches) and a card. where should i drop it?
Eli: Mira — leave cards at reception or DM me, Ill collect. thank you!!
Asha: tiny signup so we don't duplicate things: 
Asha: ```
Fri 15:00 — Kitchen
- Asha: cake (chocolate)
- Marco: plates + forks
- Mira: savory snacks (mini quiches)
- Priya: drinks
- Noor: card + confetti (optional)
- Lina: napkins
```
calendar-bot: Event created — "Sam & Eli: Office Toast" Fri 15:00 — Kitchen (organizer: Eli)
Lina: i can pick up flowers too, happy to cover $25 if anyone wants to split (Venmo ok)
Asha: ill venmo $10 to @sam.pay — count me in for flowers + setup
Evan: huge congrats you two!! see you friday :heart_eyes: :tada:
Priya: quick q — is +1 allowed?
Eli: were keeping it small this time, so please no +1s — thanks for checking!
Marco: totally fine, well keep it cozy
Noor: noted, ill bring the card friday morning
Eli: thanks everyone. if you can help set up at 2:30 please ping me. really appreciate it :pray:
